widgets_values:
# Storyboard: up to 8 matching keyframes from one image with FLUX.2 Klein 4B

Edits one anchor image, a reference or a character's photo, into one keyframe per scene with FLUX.2 Klein 4B in 4 steps, each scene with its own sentence, the shared look and its own seed, and saves the keyframes as one batch.

## Models

- [flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4b-fp8/resolve/main/flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors): FLUX.2 Klein 4B, fp8, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B).
- [qwen_3_4b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors): Qwen3 4B text encoder, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B).
- [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors): FLUX.2 VAE, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev).

Rosesfield ships no weights. Each loader lists its file with a download link.
